cases.sentence: – А скажи мне, Митрич, а что ты тут делал, пока я в тамбуре был? пока я в тамбуре был погружен в свои мысли? в свои мысли о своем чувстве? к ___?
cases.explain: «любимой женщине» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: "But tell me, Mitrich, what did you do in here while I was out in the vestibule? While | was sunk in my own thoughts out there, in my own thoughts about my own feeling for a beloved woman? Hmmm? Tell me..."

cases.translation: The grandfather broke down first and burst into tears, and the grandson after him. His upper lip entirely disap- peared, while his lower one dangled down. Both cried.

cases.translation: "T understand you. Yes. I can understand everything. If I feel like forgiving you . . .I’ve got a soul the size of the Trojan horse’s belly; it'll hold a lot. And you were simply impelled to drink whatever you found there in place of that which you wanted."’

cases.sentence: Он – тоже, он пил на чужбинку, он пил только краденое: утащит, например, в аптеке флакон ___, пойдет в туалет у вокзала и там тихонько выпьет.
cases.explain: «тройного одеколона» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: ‘"You remind me of a little old man in Petushki. He, too, drank only other people’s stuff, he drank only stolen stuff. He’d lift a bottle of Triple eau de cologne from the pharmacy, go into the toilet at the station, and drink it on the sly. He called this drinking Bruderschaft; he was seriously convinced that this was drinking Bruderschaft and he died like that, in his delusion. So, what’s up? Didn’t you decide to drink Bruderschaft?"

cases.explain: «целый ковш» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: We poured ourselves each his own stuff. Grandad and grandson waited for theirs—it turns out they were ready for it before I beckoned to them. Grandad pulled out the empty quarter bottle; I recognized it at once. And grand- son pulled out a whole pitcher, pulled it out from some- where between his pelvis and his diaphragm.
